name: Cultist Hierophant

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes three attacks, using Pact Blade or Radiant Ray in any combination.

action.name: Pact Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) Slashing damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Radiant damage.

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

fluffEntries: Cultist Hierophant: stat block oficial XMM (5.5e), elevado ao ND 13 para o modo fatal.
